package.name: f1tenth_rl_vehicle
package.description: Lean C++ vehicle integration layer for the F1TENTH QRSAC policy. Bridges the f1tenth_stack (particle filter + VESC + ackermann_mux) to the RL agent: builds the 380-dim observation from map-frame pose and body twist at a fixed 10 Hz (vehicle_obs), and converts policy actions into Ackermann drive commands with a watchdog stop (drive). The Python policy_inference node runs the actor.
